title: Understanding Private Access Session Status Codes

blocks.text: Private Access (ZPA) session status codes appear on the User Activity Diagnostics page. Each table has its own search field and can be sorted by column.
Status codes are prefixed by the related Private Access component:

blocks.item: CLT: The Zscaler Client Connector component.
SE: The Public Service Edge for Private Access or Private Service Edge for Private Access component.
ZPA BA: The Browser Access service.

blocks.text: The types of session status codes available are:

blocks.item: The following is a list of Error status codes:

table: Session Status
Internal Reason
Description
Resolution
AC: App Connector in paused state for upgrade
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_AST_IN_PAUSE_STATE_FOR_UPGRADE
The App Connector is in a paused state for upgrade. The App Connector returns to a normal state after the upgrade completes.
No action required.
AC: Application Segment not configured
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_APP_NOT_FOUND
The App Connector cannot set up a connection to the server because it cannot find the application in the configuration database.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Application’s Microtunnel request failed due to exceeding the rate limit.
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_RATE_LIMIT_REACHED
The App Connector rejected the application’s Microtunnel (M-Tunnel) request because the rate limit threshold for the specific domain was exceeded. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
Try again later. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Cannot open connection to server
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_OPEN_SERVER_CONN
The App Connector encountered an error when setting up a data connection to the server.
Ensure that the App Connector can reach the application.
AC: Cannot open connection to Service Edge
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_OPEN_BROKER_CONN
The App Connector encountered an error when opening a connection to the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
Ensure that the App Connector can reach the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
AC: Cannot setup connection to Service Edge
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_INIT_FOHH_MCONN
The App Connector encountered an error when setting up a connection to the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
Ensure that the App Connector can reach the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge, and then ask the user to request the application. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Connection between server and App Connector was closed
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_OPEN_SERVER_CLOSE
During data connection setup, the connection from the server to the App Connector was closed.
Verify if the application is reachable from the App Connector, and check the available server capacity
AC: Connection database is full
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_HASH_TBL_FULL
The App Connector cannot set up a connection to the server because the connection database is full.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Connection request timed out
AST_MT_SETUP_TIMEOUT
The App Connector timed out while setting up a connection.
Ensure that the App Connector can reach the application.
AC: Connection request to server timed out
AST_MT_SETUP_TIMEOUT_CANNOT_CONN_TO_SERVER
The App Connector timed out while waiting for a connection response from the server.
Ensure that the App Connector can reach the application.
AC: Connection request to Service Edge timed out
AST_MT_SETUP_TIMEOUT_CANNOT_CONN_TO_BROKER
The App Connector cannot set up a data connection to the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
Ensure that the App Connector is able to reach the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
AC: CPU Limit Exceeded for PRA Connection
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_CPU_LIMIT_REACHED
The App Connector CPU limit is exceeded for a Privileged Remote Access (PRA) connection. No more PRA connections are allowed.
Add cores to the App Connector or add additional App Connectors. Contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
AC: Disabled in Admin Portal
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_AST_CFG_DISABLE
The Microtunnel setup has failed because the App Connector has been disabled in the Zscaler Admin Console.
No action required. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Maximum PRA Session Limit Reached
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_MAX_SESSIONS_REACHED
The maximum session limit is reached for Privileged Remote Access (PRA) connections on the App Connector.
Add cores and memory to the App Connector or add additional App Connectors. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Memory Limit Exceeded for PRA Connection
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_MEM_LIMIT_REACHED
The App Connector memory limit is exceeded for a Privileged Remote Access (PRA) connection. No more PRA connections are allowed.
Add memory to the App Connector or add additional App Connectors. Contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
AC: Service Edge not responding to connection request from App Connector
AST_MT_SETUP_TIMEOUT_NO_ACK_TO_BIND

App Connector is unable to setup a data connection to the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge. The App Connector timed out while waiting for a connection response from the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: DNS resolution failed
INVALID_DOMAIN

None of the App Connectors configured for the application could successfully resolve the hostname within three seconds of sending a DNS request. This might be because of a DNS resolution failure on the App Connector or a misconfigured DNS in the DC environment. The App Connector resolves DNS successfully, but the health check fails. This might happen because the App Connector cannot reach the application server over the network or the App Connector can reach the application server, but the server is rejecting the health check.

Ensure that the hostname is correctly configured. Verify the App Connector can consistently resolve DNS for the hostname. Check that the App Connector can reach the application server and the server accepts requests on the expected ports. Ensure that services between the App Connector and the application server (e.g., access control lists, host-based firewalls, etc.) allow them to communicate on the expected ports and protocols.
AC: DNS resolution failed for unmonitored app
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_NO_DNS_TO_SERVER

The end host (not a proxy or a configured server group) is not resolvable. The code only comes up in a specific use case when there is all of the following: No-health application Dynamic server discovery is enabled (i.e., no server group configured) The target application has failed to resolve
Execute the Linux Shell Command with the URL that failed in the transaction to understand why the DNS resolution is failing, and why the App Connector is failing the DNS.
AC: Duplicate connection tag ID
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_DUP_MT_ID
The App Connector cannot set up a data connection because another data connection with the same tag ID already exists.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Error connecting to server
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_OPEN_SERVER_ERROR

The App Connector experienced an error while setting up a data connection to a specific server. This was because the application server closed the connection with TCP Reset (RST), the server was not listening on the port, or the App Connector did not support PRA.
Verify if the application is reachable from the App Connector, check the available server capacity, or contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
AC: Error connecting to server due to missing PRA support on App Connector
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_PRA_UNAVAILABLE
The App Connector experienced an error while setting up a PRA connection. This was because the App Connector did not support PRA.
Enable the necessary subcomponent for PRA on your App Connector group. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Error in creating Service Edge-server connection
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_CONN_PEER
The App Connector encountered an error when connecting the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge and server connections.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Error in data connection to Service Edge
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_BROKER_BIND_FAIL
The App Connector encountered an error when setting up a data connection to the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Error in local connection
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_BIND_TO_AST_LOCAL_OWNER
The App Connector processing the data connection request has encountered an error.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Error in non local connection
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_BIND_GLOBAL_OWNER
The App Connector processing the data connection request encountered an error.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Error processing response from Service Edge
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_BIND_ACK
The connection confirmation from the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge has an error.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: File descriptors are exhausted
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_NO_SYSTEM_FD
The transaction failed as the operating system has run out of file descriptors.
Increase the number of file descriptors that are available on the host. To learn more, see Monitoring App Connector Performance.
AC: File descriptors are exhausted for App Connector process
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_NO_PROCESS_FD
The transaction failed as the App Connector processing could not secure additional file descriptors from the operating system.

Increase the number of App Connectors in the App Connector group.To learn more, see Adding App Connectors to an Existing App Connector Group. If the App Connector group is set up for a wildcard application, try creating more application segments along with App Connector groups in order to have greater load distribution across the App Connector groups.
AC: Service Edge database is full
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_BRK_HASH_TBL_FULL
The App Connector cannot set up a connection to the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge because the connection database is full.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
AC: Source ports are exhausted
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_NO_EPHEMERAL_PORT
The transaction failed as the operating system has run out of source ports.
Increase the number of ports. To learn more, see Monitoring App Connector Performance.
AC: Timeout connecting to server
AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_OPEN_SERVER_TIMEOUT
App Connector timed out while setting up a data connection to a specific server.
Verify if the application is reachable from the App Connector, and check the application latency.
AC: Disabled Web probe
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_WEBPROBE_HTTPS_DISABLED
The Web probe request cannot be sent to the App Connector because the Web probe is disabled.
Enable the Web probe.
CA: App Connector health information request timed out
DSP_MT_SETUP_FAIL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT
The health information request timed out when attempting to reach the App Connector.
Ensure that the App Connector can reach the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
CA: App Connector is not available
NO_CONNECTOR_AVAILABLE

None of the App Connectors are configured to reach this application. None of the App Connectors have learned the configuration for this application even though the application is associated with App Connectors through configuration. The application was just configured or the App Connector has just restarted and is still learning its configuration. The App Connector is unable to learn its configuration from the Private Access certificate authority (CA).
Ensure that at least one App Connector group is configured to reach this application. Ask the user to access the application again. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CA: Application is not available
APP_NOT_AVAILABLE
The application segment is not configured for access.
Ensure that the application segment is configured in the Zscaler Admin Console. Ask the user to access the application again. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CA: Application is not reachable
APP_NOT_REACHABLE
None of the App Connectors configured for the application can reach the server.
Ensure that the App Connector can reach the server. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CA: Cannot find tunnels for ZPA Public Service Edge
ZPN_ERR_EXTRANET_NO_TUNNEL_AVAILABLE
No eligible tunnels were found to send user information to.
Verify and validate tunnel information. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CA: Error communicating with Service Edge
DSP_MT_SETUP_FAIL_CANNOT_SEND_TO_BROKER
The path selection service is unable to communicate with the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
Ask the user to access the application again. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CA: Missing information for continuous health reporting
DSP_MT_SETUP_FAIL_MISSING_HEALTH
The App Connector was unable to process the continuous health report due to missing health information.
Ensure that the App Connector can reach the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
CA: Missing locations
ZPN_ERR_EXTRANET_NO_LOCATIONS_ASSOCIATED
No locations were found for the associated application.
Select a valid location for the associated application.
CLT: Connection failed
CLT_CONN_FAILED
The incoming TCP connection failed.
Verify that the application is listening on the port.
CLT: DoubleEncrypt not supported
CLT_DOUBLEENCRYPT_NOT_SUPPORTED
The double encryption of the incoming Microtunnel request is not supported by the Zscaler Client Connector.
Do not configure the application segment applying remote assistance to use double encryption. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CLT: Duplicate tag
CLT_DUPLICATE_TAG
The tag ID is used in the Zscaler Client Connector.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CLT: Invalid client
CLT_INVALID_CLIENT
The receiving Zscaler Client Connector device doesn't match with the request.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CLT: Invalid domain
CLT_INVALID_DOMAIN
The FQDN destination host doesn't match the receiving Zscaler Client Connector detected.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CLT: Invalid tag
CLT_INVALID_TAG
The tag ID is not designed for the incoming Microtunnel flow.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CLT: Multiple clients registered with the same domain
MULTIPLE_CLIENT_REGISTRATIONS_FOR_DOMAIN
Zscaler Client Connector rejected the connection request due to multiple clients registered with the same domain.
Try again later. Ensure that no two clients are registered with the same domain. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CLT: Port unreachable
CLT_PORT_UNREACHABLE
The port is not listening.
Verify that the application is running on the port or remove the port in the application configuration.
CLT: Probe failed
CLT_PROBE_FAILED
The port probe failed.
Verify that the application is running on the port or remove the port in the application configuration.
CLT: Protocol not supported
CLT_PROTOCOL_NOT_SUPPORTED
The IP protocol of the incoming Microtunnel request is not supported by the Zscaler Client Connector.
Verify that the initiating client machine does connect to the receiving Zscaler Client Connector with a protocol other than TCP, UDP, or ICMP. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CLT: Read failed
CLT_READ_FAILED
The Zscaler Client Connector local socket read failed.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
CLT: Wrong port
CLT_WRONG_PORT
The incoming Microtunnel request asks for the listening ports of the Zscaler Client Connector itself.
Verify that the initiating client machine does not connect to the receiving Zscaler Client Connector listening ports.
SE: App Connector disabled via Private Service Edge
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_SERVICE_DISABLED
The Private Service Edge disabled the App Connector.
Ensure that the App Connector is able to reach the Private Service Edge.
SE: App Connector group not configured
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_CONNECTOR_GROUPS_MISSING
The Public Service Edge was unable to process the application request since an App Connector group was not specified in the Server group configuration.
Edit the server group to add the App Connector groups. To learn more, see Editing Server Groups.
SE: Application access blocked because user was not active with SCIM
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_SCIM_INACTIVE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge has failed to set up the data connection due to the user being deactivated or not synced in SCIM.
Ask an admin to sync user accounts via SCIM to activate users. To learn more, see About SCIM. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Application approval policy blocked access
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_REJECTED_BY_POLICY_APPROVAL
The Private Access service blocked the application request because the user isn't allowed to access the application at this time.
Update the approval policy to allow the user access in the time window.
SE: Application not configured
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_APP_NOT_FOUND
The Public Service Edge or the Private Service Edge cannot set up a connection since the application is not configured.
Ensure that the application and application segment is configured in the Zscaler Admin Console. Ask the user to access the application again. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Authentication failed due to insufficient memory
BRK_MT_AUTH_SAML_CANNOT_ADD_ATTR_TO_HEAP
Authentication failed because of insufficient memory to process the SAML response.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Authentication failed due to insufficient resources
BRK_MT_AUTH_SAML_CANNOT_ADD_ATTR_TO_HASH
Authentication failed because of insufficient resources to process the SAML response.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Authentication level expired
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_REAUTH_EXPIRED_WITH_AL
The Public Service Edge was unable to process the application request since the Authentication Level (for Step-Up Authentication) expired.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Authentication Level required
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_REAUTH_WITH_AL
The Public Service Edge was unable to process the application request since the user does not have the required Authentication Level.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Authentication unsuccessful
BRK_MT_AUTH_SAML_FAILURE
The user's authentication to Private Access was unsuccessful.
The user must authenticate with valid credentials.
SE: B2B Federated application access failed
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_B2B_ACCESS_DENIED
Application access for the Business-to-Business (B2B) Federation was denied.
No action required. Contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: B2B Federated application access is terminated due to connectivity issues
BRK_MT_TERMINATED_B2B_BROKER_CHANGED
The active connection for B2B Federation was terminated due to network connectivity issues, or the B2B Federation status was changed.
No action required. Contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Cannot complete data connection setup
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_CANNOT_SEND_MT_COMPLETE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge encountered an error when processing the data connection request from Zscaler Client Connector or the App Connector.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Cannot find ZIA Public Service Edge to service the request
BRK_MT_BROKER_REQUEST_ZVPN_NOT_FOUND
Cannot find the Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS to service the request.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Cannot send Microtunnel request
BRK_MT_ZVPN_ERROR
The Public Service Edge for Private Access cannot process the Microtunnel request.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Cannot send Microtunnel request as Extranet client is disabled for tenant
BRK_MT_REJECT_EXTRANET_CLIENT_NOT_ENABLED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge rejected the Microtunnel request because Extranet is disabled for your tenant.
Contact Zscaler Support to enable Extranet for your tenant.
SE: Cannot send Microtunnel request for Extranet application as Extranet is disabled
BRK_MT_REJECT_EXTRANET_NOT_ENABLED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge rejected the Microtunnel request because Extranet is disabled.
Contact Zscaler Support to enable Extranet feature for the customer to continue sending Microtunnel requests.
SE: Cannot send Microtunnel request to Extranet application as Extranet is hard disabled.
BRK_MT_REJECT_HARD_DISABLED_EXTRANET
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge rejected the Microtunnel request because Extranet is hard disabled.
Contact Zscaler Support to remove the hard disable feature flag for Extranet to continue sending Microtunnel requests.
SE: Error in promoting connection to Public Service Edge
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_CANNOT_PROMOTE

The Private Service Edge cannot promote the application tunnel to the Public Service Edge. The Public Service Edge might be unreachable, or the Private Service Edge is setting up a data connection with the Public Service Edge.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Exceeded limit or connection request attempts
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_REPEATED_DISPATCH
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was unable to establish a data connection within the limit of the connection request attempts.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Just-in-Time Approval timed out
BRK_MT_TERMINATED_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge terminated the session and caused a timeout due to approval time window expiration.
Ask the user to access the application in the approved time window. Update the approvals for the user.
SE: Maximum workload groups exceeded
BRK_MT_REJECT_MAX_WTAG_EXCEEDED
The workload groups have exceeded the maximum limit. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
Reduce the number of workload groups.
SE: Remote assistance connection expired
C2C_CLIENT_CONN_EXPIRED
The client connection expired during the initiation of a remote assistance session.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Remote assistance connection in a bad state
C2C_MTUNNEL_BAD_STATE
The remote assistance connection expired due to inconsistencies in the connection.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Remote assistance connection not found
C2C_MTUNNEL_NOT_FOUND
The remote assistance connection is not found.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Remote assistance connection unavailable
C2C_NOT_AVAILABLE
The remote assistance connection is not available.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Remote assistance destination client not found
C2C_CLIENT_NOT_FOUND
The client connection is closed during the initiation of a remote assistance session.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Connection failed due to rate limiting
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge rejected the Microtunnel request because the rate limit threshold for the specific domain was exceeded. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
If the request rate is expected or the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection failed due to the number of application domains exceeded
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_RATE_LIMIT_NUM_APP_EXCEEDED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge rejected the Microtunnel request because the rate limit threshold for different domains was exceeded. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
If the request rate is expected or the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection failed due to Microtunnel loop
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_RATE_LIMIT_LOOP_DETECTED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge rejected the Microtunnel request because a potential Microtunnel creation loop was detected. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
Check if the traffic from the App Connector is routed to the Cloud Connector. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection failed due to rate limiting for ICMP requests
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_ICMP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge rejected the ICMP Microtunnel requests because the rate limit threshold for the specific domain was exceeded.
If the request rate is expected or the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection failed due to the number of ICMP requests with different domains exceeded
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_ICMP_RATE_LIMIT_NUM_APP_EXCEEDED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge rejected the ICMP Microtunnel requests because the rate limit threshold for new domains was exceeded.
If the request rate is expected or the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection failed due to the reached limit of failed attempts
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_TOO_MANY_FAILED_ATTEMPTS

The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge has received the exceeded limit of errors to accept any additional connection requests for this domain. New requests are not received until the preset waiting period has elapsed.
SE: Connection failed either for memory unavailable or because of an SSL error
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_MEMORY

The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection closed because a memory error due to the read buffer on the connection is not allocated, or the SSL state from the SSL context is unavailable.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Connection failed to forward ZPA Public Service Edge request to ZIA Public Service Edge
BRK_MT_BROKER_REQUEST_FAIL_SEND_TO_ZVPN
Connection failed while processing the Public Service Edge request to the Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection failed to the destination client
C2C_MTUNNEL_FAILED_FORWARD
The remote assistance connection failed to initiate the connection to the destination client and expired.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Connection request timed out
BRK_MT_SETUP_TIMEOUT

The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was waiting for a data connection request from an App Connector that could provide access to the application, but the request timed out while waiting. The request from an App Connector is triggered in response to the initial application request from the Zscaler Client Connector.
Ensure that the App Connectors can reach the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge and the requested application.
SE: Connection terminated due to processing ZPA service changes
MT_CLOSED_TLS_CONN_GONE_MANUAL_DRAIN
The existing connection was terminated due to processing Private Access service changes between the application and the Public Service Edge.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection terminated due to SCIM mapping changes
MT_CLOSED_TLS_CONN_GONE_SCIM_USER_MOVED
The existing connection was terminated due to changes in the SCIM user mapping. Sessions are terminated, and the client will reconnect automatically.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection to ZIA Public Service Edge was terminated.
BRK_MT_CLOSED_ZIA_CONN_GONE_CLOSED
Connection to the Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS was terminated.
Retry the connection to the application. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Connection upgrade request is forbidden
BRK_CONN_UPGRADE_REQUEST_FORBIDDEN
Zscaler Client Connector sent a connection upgrade request to a Public Service Edge and it is forbidden.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection upgrade request is failed
BRK_CONN_UPGRADE_REQUEST_FAILED
Zscaler Client Connector sent a connection upgrade request to a Public Service Edge and it failed.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Connection is terminated due to broker switch
BRK_MT_TERMINATED_BRK_SWITCHED
The Zscaler Client Connector connection to a Public Service Edge was terminated due to a Public Service Edge initiated switch.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: Customer not enabled
CUSTOMER_NOT_ENABLED
Remote assistance communication is disabled for the current customer.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: DNS resolution failed
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_PROXY_DNS
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the address resolution for this destination is no longer available.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Duplicate connection tag ID
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_DUPLICATE_TAG_ID
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge cannot set up a data connection because another data connection with the same tag ID already exists.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Error communicating with CA
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_CANNOT_SEND_TO_DISPATCHER

The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge cannot communicate with the CA. The CA might be unreachable, the Public Service Edge's connection with the CA could be busy, or the Private Service Edge's connection with the CA could be busy.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Error due to SCIM user deactivated
ZPN_ERR_SCIM_INACTIVE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge received an error because a SCIM user was deactivated.
If the user is allowed access, ensure that SCIM is enabled. If the user’s access is blocked, ensure that the IdP is enabled and that the SCIM sync is working for that IdP.
SE: Error in associating connection to App Connector
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_BIND_TO_AST_LOCAL_OWNER
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge encountered an error when processing the data connection request from Zscaler Client Connector or the App Connector.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Error in associating connection to Client Connector
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_BIND_TO_CLIENT_LOCAL_OWNER
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge encountered an error while processing an application request from Zscaler Client Connector.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Error in connection callback
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_CALLBACK_ERR
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection callback returned an error.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Error in finding the App Connector
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_CTRL_BRK_CANNOT_FIND_CONNECTOR
The connection to the Public Service Edge failed because the Public Service Edge could not find the App Connector.
No action required.
SE: Error in finding customer
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge cannot retrieve customer information due to a configuration error when processing the data connection request.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User session has expired
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_REAUTH_EXPIRED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge cannot set up a data connection because reauthentication is required.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Error in filling App Connector groups
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_NO_ASSISTANT_GROUPS
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge cannot fill App Connector groups due to a configuration error when processing the data request.
Ask the user to validate configuration. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Extranet client cannot access Extranet application
EAS_MT_PARTNER_TO_PARTNER_NOT_SUPPORTED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge rejected the Microtunnel or DNS request because the Extranet client cannot access the Extranet application.
No action required. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Failed to get Branch Connector details
ZPN_AUTH_ERR_BC_GET_FAILED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was disconnected because the Branch Connector details could not be retrieved.
No action required. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Failed to process SAML response
BRK_MT_AUTH_SAML_DECODE_FAIL
The Private Access service rejected the user's authentication request because the verification of the SAML response failed.
Verify the SSO configuration in Private Access and your IdP.
SE: Failed to verify the fingerprint of SAML response
BRK_MT_AUTH_SAML_FINGER_PRINT_FAIL
The Private Access service rejected the user's authentication request because the fingerprint of the SAML response could not be verified.
Ask the user to logout of the Zscaler Client Connector and log in again. Make sure that the username portion of their email address is being entered using lowercase letters.
SE: FQDN bad regex
FQDN_BAD_REGEX
The configured regex in the Zscaler Admin Console is incorrect.
Contact your Admin to fix the incorrect regex. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: FQDN bad schema
FQDN_BAD_SCHEMA
Remote assistance communication is disabled for the Public Service Edge.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: FQDN empty
FQDN_EMPTY
The FQDN received from the Zscaler Client Connector is null or empty.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: FQDN no entries
FQDN_NO_ENTRIES
Your admin has not configured a regex in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Contact your admin to configure a regex in the Zscaler Admin Console. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: FQDN no match
FQDN_NO_MATCH
The hostname does not match with the configured regex.
Contact your admin to fix the FQDN or configure the regex. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: FQDN has too many regex
FQDN_TOO_MANY_REGEX
Invalid regex configuration due to multiple configured regex statements.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Internal Error
MT_CLOSED_INTERNAL_ERROR
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge closed the application session due to an internal error.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Multiple authentication failures
BRK_MT_AUTH_ALREADY_FAILED
Authentication failed more than once.
Ask the user to log out of Zscaler Client Connector and log in with valid credentials.
SE: Proxy connection failed for parsing HTTP response
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_PROXY_PARSE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection through the proxy was closed because the proxy modified the HTTP fields, which caused parsing issues.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Proxy connection issue
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_PROXY_FAIL

The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed due to one of the following proxy connection issues received: a failed connection, inability to send a connection request, or an error from the proxy.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Proxy connection status unavailable
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_SETSOCKOPT
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the status of the proxy connection was unavailable.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: SAML assertion is absent
BRK_MT_AUTH_NO_SAML_ASSERTION_IN_MSG
The Private Access service rejected the user's authentication request because the SAML assertion is absent in the SAML response.
Verify the single-sign-on (SSO) configuration in Private Access and your IdP.
SE: SAML assertion is too large
BRK_MT_AUTH_TWO_SAML_ASSERTION_IN_MSG
The Private Access service rejected the user's authentication request because the SAML assertion is too large.
Verify the SSO configuration in Private Access and your IdP.
SE: Serializer cannot serialize internal control message
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_SERIALIZE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the serializer was unable to serialize an internal control message.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Service Edge not enabled
BROKER_NOT_ENABLED
Remote assistance communication is disabled for the Public Service Edge.
To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Socket error
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_SOCKET_ERR
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed due to a socket error.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Status callbacks not registered
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_REGISTRATION
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was unable to register status callbacks.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Unexpected data connection request
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_BIND_RECV_IN_BAD_STATE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge received an unexpected data connection request from the App Connector for providing access to the requested application.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User’s application registration failed
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_APP_FAIL
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection closed because the user’s application registration failed.
Ensure that the App Connector can reach the user’s application.
SE: User's authentication expired
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_TIMEOUT
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the user’s authentication expired.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User’s authentication failed
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_CUSTOMER_FAIL
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection closed because the user’s authentication failed.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User’s authentication is incomplete
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_NOT_COMPLETE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection closed because the user could not be authenticated.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User authentication timed out
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_EXPIRED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was disconnected because the user’s authentication timed out.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User authentication timed out due to expired SAML
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_SAML_EXPIRED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was disconnected because the user’s SAML authentication expired, causing an authentication timeout.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User’s certificate expired
ZPN_ERR_CERT_EXPIRED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the user’s certificate either expired or was deleted.
Ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User’s group ID is missing
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_CUSTOMER_MISSING
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection closed because the user’s group ID was not received.
Confirm the user’s group ID and ask the user to reauthenticate. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User's Microtenants are not configured
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_SCOPE_NOT_CREATED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was disconnected because the user's Microtenants are not configured.
Enable the Microtenant, or contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: User's Microtenant does not exist
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was disconnected because the user's Microtenant does not exist.
Review the Microtenant configuration, and if necessary, initiate the Zero Trust Branch instance for the appropriate Microtenant.
SE: User's Microtenant is disabled
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_SCOPE_NOT_ENABLED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was disconnected because the user's Microtenant is disabled.
Enable the Microtenant, or contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: User's Microtenant is disabled or does not belong to the Private Service Edge
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was disconnected because the user's Microtenant is disabled, or the Branch Connector belongs to another Microtenant.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: User's Microtenant is invalid
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_SCOPE_INVALID
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was disconnected because the user's Microtenant is invalid.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: User's Microtenant is not configured due to internal issue
ZPN_ERR_AUTH_SCOPE_NOT_CONFIGURED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was disconnected because the user's Microtenants are not configured due to an internal error.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support to learn more.
SE: User has been disabled
ZPN_ERR_CUSTOMER_DISABLED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the user is flagged as disabled.
If the user was not disabled, ask the user to reauthenticate. If the issue persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: User information missing in SAML response
BRK_MT_AUTH_SAML_NO_USER_ID
The Private Access service rejected the user's authentication request because the user's information is missing in the SAML message.
Verify the SSO configuration in Private Access and your IdP.
SE: User termination request received from SCIM
ZPN_ERR_SCIM_INACTIVE
The Private Access service closed the connection due to the user being disabled via SCIM. All active application sessions were terminated.
No action required.
SE: ZIA inspection was performed, but it was blocked for violating security reasons.
ZIA_MT_BLOCKED_BY_INSPECTION
Internet & SaaS (ZIA) inspection was performed, but it was blocked for violating security reasons.
No action required.
SE: ZIA inspection was performed, but there was an internal system problem. This was not a security problem.
ZIA_MT_BLOCKED_BY_SYSTEM_ERROR
Internet & SaaS inspection was performed, but there was an internal system problem. This was not a security problem.
Retry the connection to the application. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
ZPA BA: CA was Not Trusted
EXPTR_MT_TLS_SETUP_FAIL_NOT_TRUSTED_CA
The application server certificate is not signed by a trusted CA and Private Access is configured to verify that the web server certificate is signed by a trusted CA.
Either specify HTTP as the protocol for this application, replace the existing certificate with a certificate signed by a trusted CA, or use Untrusted Certificates.
ZPA BA: Cert Chaining Issue
EXPTR_MT_TLS_SETUP_FAIL_CERT_CHAIN_ISSUE
Private Access is not able to validate the chain of trust for the server certificate configured for this application.
Upload the web server certificate including the entire chain of trust for the certificate.
ZPA BA: Network connection error
EXPTR_FCONN_GONE
User access fails due to a network error that caused the Browser Access service to remove the user's application sessions.
Ask the user to refresh the application in the browser.
ZPA BA: TLS setup failed with peer
EXPTR_MT_TLS_SETUP_FAIL_PEER
The Browser Access service cannot set up a HTTPS connection towards the web server due to an issue occurring during TLS setup.
The issue is most likely due to an invalid web server certificate being used. Verify that the web server certificate configured for the application is valid.
ZPA BA: TLS Wrong Version Number
EXPTR_MT_TLS_SETUP_FAIL_VERSION_MISMATCH
A TLS version mismatch between Private Access and the Browser Access-enabled application occurred. This happens when the web server is running TLS 1.0/1.1 or earlier versions.
Enable TLS 1.2 on the web server.

blocks.item: The following is a list of Info status codes:

table: Session Status
Internal Reason
Description
Resolution
AC: Connection closed successfully
AST_MT_TERMINATED
The connection to the App Connector was terminated without issue.
No action required.
SE: App Connector disconnected to ZPA Private Service Edge
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_AST_PBRK_DATA_DOWN
The Private Service Edge connection to the App Connector was disconnected.
Ensure that the App Connector is able to reach the Private Service Edge.
SE: Connection closed by App Connector
BRK_MT_CLOSED_FROM_ASSISTANT
The App Connector closed the application Microtunnel (M-Tunnel) as a result of the application server terminating the TCP session with a TCP FIN.
No action required.
SE: Callback for Server Name Indication maxed out
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_SNI_SLOW
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection closed because the maximum number of Server Name Indication (SNI) callbacks was reached.
No action required.
SE: Connection closed by server
BRK_MT_RESET_FROM_SERVER
The application server terminated the connection with TCP RST.
No action required.
SE: Callback for Server Name Indication timed out
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_SNI_TIMEOUT
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection is closed because the wait time for SNI callbacks has expired.
No action required.
SE: Client Connector TLS session not present
MT_CLOSED_TLS_CONN_GONE_CLIENT_CLOSED

The connection from the Zscaler Client Connector to Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was terminated, resulting in the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge terminating all application sessions for that Zscaler Client Connector.
No action required.
SE: App Connector TLS session not present
MT_CLOSED_TLS_CONN_GONE_AST_CLOSED

The connection from the App Connector to the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was terminated, resulting in the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge terminating all application sessions for that App Connector.
No action required.
SE: Connection closed by Client Connector
BRK_MT_CLOSED_FROM_CLIENT

The connection from the App Connector to the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was terminated, resulting in the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge terminating all application sessions for that App Connector.
No action required.
SE: Connection closed by Service Edge
BRK_MT_TERMINATED
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge closed the application tunnel connection. This is part of the Service Edge’s regular process at the end of an application request.
No action required.
SE: Connection closed due to missing Server Name Indication
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_SNI_MISSING
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection is closed because the SNI is missing.
No action required.
SE: Connection closed successfully
MT_CLOSED_TERMINATED
The connection to the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge was terminated without issue.
No action required.
SE: Connection failed because HTTP return code was not 200
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_HTTP_RESPONSE

The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the returned code was not 200. The returned code 200 means that a connection is OK. If the code does not come back with 200, the connection is closed.
No action required.
SE: Connection redirected to another Service Edge
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_BROKER_REDIRECT
The Private Service Edge connection was redirected to another Private Service Edge due to a restart for maintenance or upgrade purposes.
No action required.
SE: Connection redirected to another Service Edge
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_REDIRECT
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was redirected to another Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge.
No action required.
SE: Connection request timed out
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge timed out while setting up a connection. This is not an error scenario, only a function of the service.
No action required.
SE: Connection request to server timed out
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_RX_TIMEOUT
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection timed out while waiting for a connection response from the server.
No action required.
SE: Connection timed out
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_TIMEOUT

The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge keeps the user's application session alive for the time interval specified by the Idle Connection Timeout prior to terminating the session. This is not an error scenario, only a function of the service.
No action required.
SE: Connection verification failed
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_CERT_VERIFY
The Public Service Edge or ZPA Private Service Edge connection was unable to verify the server certificate.
No action required.
SE: Data connection idle to App Connector
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_AST_DATA_CONN_FLOW_CONTROL
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge data connection was closed by App Connector because the connection was idle or blocked for more than 5 minutes.
No action required.
SE: Data connection idle to Service Edge
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_BRK_DATA_CONN_FLOW_CONTROL
The data connection was closed by the Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge because the connection was idle or blocked for more than 5 minutes.
No action required.
SE: Deserialization error with callback
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_TLV_CALLBACK
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed due to a deserialization error.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Deserialization error with no callback
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_TLV_NO_CALLBACK
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed due to a deserialization error.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: End of file received, closing connection
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_SOCKET_CLOSE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the end of the file was received. This is not an error scenario, only a function of the service.
No action required.
SE: Flow control timed out
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_DATA_CONN_FLOW_CONTROL
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because flow control was blocked for more than 5 minutes.
No action required.
SE: Log channel reconnection timed out
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_LOG_RECONN
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge reconnection to the log channels timed out because the reconnection timer expired.
No action required.
SE: Protocol data mismatched during parsing
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_TLV_LEN
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed during parsing due to a protocol data mismatch.
No action required.
SE: Proxy connection failed for HTTP response error 200
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_PROXY_NOT_200

The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection through the proxy was closed because the returned code was not 200. The returned code 200 means that a connection is OK. If the code does not come back with 200, the connection is closed.
Check the proxy connection. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Proxy connection request timed out
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_PROXY_TIMEOUT
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the connection through the proxy exceeded the proxy timeout value.
No action required.
SE: Proxy connection timed out
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_PROXY_IDLE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection closed because the connection through the proxy timed out.
No action required.
SE: Request was successful
OPEN_OR_ACTIVE_CONNECTION
The connection is active and working.
No action required.
SE: SSL context not found
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_SSL_CTX_NONE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection closed because it was unable to identify the SSL context.
No action required.
SE: Timeout policy closed idle connection
BRK_MT_TERMINATED_IDLE_TIMEOUT

If an idle timeout is configured, Private Access will keep the user's application session alive for the interval specified by the Idle Connection Timeout prior to terminating the session. This is not an error scenario, only a function of the service.
No action required.
SE: TLS session not present
MT_CLOSED_TLS_CONN_GONE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge closed the application session because the parent TLS session to Zscaler Client Connector or the App Connector is no longer present.

Typically, application sessions are closed by the ZPA Public Service Edge or ZPA Private Service Edge when users disconnect from the service. Normally, no further action is required. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Unable to deserialize protocol data
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_TLV_DESERIALIZE
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed because the protocol data could not be deserialized.
If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support.
SE: Unexpected data connection to ZPA Private Service Edge
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_AST_PBRK_VERIFY_FAILED
The Private Service Edge connection was closed because the connection was made with a Private Service Edge different than the expected Private Service Edge.
No action required.
SE: User closed connection
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_OPS
The Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge connection was closed at the user’s request.
No action required.
SE: User disabled via SCIM
MT_CLOSED_TLS_CONN_GONE_SCIM_USER_DISABLE
The Private Access service closed the connection due to the user being disabled via SCIM.
No action required.
SE: ZPA Private Service Edge configuration changed
FOHH_CLOSE_REASON_AST_PBRK_CTRL_CONN_CFG_CHG
The Private Service Edge connection was closed due to a change in the Private Service Edge configuration.
No action required.

blocks.item: The following is a list of Policy Block status codes:

table: Session Status
Internal Reason
Description
Resolution
SE: Application policy blocked access
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_REJECTED_BY_POLICY
The Private Access service blocked the application request because the user isn't allowed to access the requested application.
Update the policy to allow the user.
SE: Application policy blocked access due to device failing a posture check
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_REJECTED_BY_POLICY_POSTURE_FAILED

The Private Access service blocked the application request because the device posture check failed. The device does not meet the required security posture criteria (e.g., missing security updates, disabled antivirus, etc.).
Confirm all security posture requirements are met for the device (e.g., update the operating system, enable antivirus software, etc.).
SE: Policy is not configured for access
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_NO_POLICY_FOUND

The Private Access service blocked the application request because a policy isn't configured for the requested application. The application request is also blocked when an application segment or a segment group is disabled.
Update the policy to allow the user. Enable the application segment and segment group.
SE: Timeout policy blocked access
BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_SAML_EXPIRED
The Private Access service blocked the application or Web Browser request because the timeout policy requires the user to authenticate.
The user must reauthenticate in Zscaler Client Connector. If needed, update the timeout policy to increase the interval before a timeout. To learn more, see Configuring Timeout Policies.
